purpose: Environment metadata for all host measurements in this project. Host timings describe this implementation on this machine only; they are never converted into Solana compute units.

fips204.role: ML-DSA-44 and ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204), pure mode, empty context, randomized/hedged signing

fips205.role: SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s (FIPS 205), pure mode, empty context, hedged signing

getrandom.role: OS randomness for Ed25519 seed generation

solana-sdk.role: actual transaction serialization for the M4 transport analysis

bincode.role: classic Solana wire serialization (1232-byte packet limit)

ml-dsa.role: Independent FIPS 204 (final) implementation (RustCrypto/signatures), used only for the ML-DSA interop cross-check test

notable_transitive_dependencies.solana split crates: solana-transaction 5.1.0, solana-message 5.1.0, solana-program 5.1.0, solana-pubkey 4.2.0 (Pubkey is an alias for Address)

signing_modes.ml-dsa-44: FIPS 204 pure mode, context = empty string, randomized (hedged) signing
signing_modes.ml-dsa-65: FIPS 204 pure mode, context = empty string, randomized (hedged) signing
signing_modes.slh-dsa-sha2-128s: FIPS 205 pure mode, context = empty string, hedged signing
